findings.evidence: REPRODUCED THIS ROUND (vision, sips 2x crop /tmp top-left quadrant of 02-pile-with-cards.png): card N°C691736 header renders the red elapsed timer clipped at the card's orange right border so only '8299' shows; the trailing ':10' seconds AND the 'Attente' label are shaved off. DOM truth (02-pile-with-cards.dom.html .kds-card__elapsed) = '8299:10' (also '8309:10','8289:10' on the other seeds; state 04 '8305', state 06b '8295'/'8285'). ROOT CAUSE (CSS extracted this round): .kds-card has `overflow: hidden`; the KDS-R1-01 heal already gave .kds-card__queue/.kds-card__elapsed/.kds-card__elapsed-wrap `flex-shrink:0; overflow:visible` (so flex never COMPRESSES the timer) but the parent card's overflow:hidden still SHAVES anything overrunning the card's right edge. A 4-digit-minute value 'N°C691736  8299:10' exceeds the card content budget -> trailing edge clipped. MEASURED-P1 RULE: clip cuts the timer SECONDS + the static 'Attente' label, NOT a critical word — queue id (C691736), item name (Menu Frites+Boisson), allergens (Gluten·Lait) and the 'Prêt' CTA are all fully intact -> P2, NOT P1. THRESHOLD VERIFIED: 3-digit-minute timers render FULLY (state 01/03/05a/09-aria show '191:15','175:50','164:57','35:51','20:28' all uncut inside their cards). Clip starts only >999 min (>16.6h elapsed). The 4-digit values here are produced by the spec's DELIBERATE backdate to 2026-05-28 12:00 (~138h, disclosed in spec lines 144-147) to force FIFO front-slot ordering; a production order at 16h+ unbumped is abnormal and even then loses only the (operationally irrelevant) seconds. KDS is an internal kitchen surface, not customer-facing.

Alternatively trim .kds-card__main gap/padding ~6px at the tight breakpoint. Verify against a real ≤2-digit timer first (those already fit) before churning layout. P2: non-blocking, disclose-only.

findings.evidence: DEGRADED PERSISTENT-OBSERVABILITY (P2, not P0 — the role=alert toast DOES fire, see C-005, so the protocol's silent_error P0 trigger does not apply). OWNER-RELEVANT FRAMING: on a SUSTAINED list-poll 5xx with WS up, the KDS resting state (09-error-banner-on-5xx.png) is the cheerful empty board — illustration + bold 'Aucune commande en cours' + 'Les nouvelles commandes apparaîtront ici' — PIXEL-IDENTICAL to a healthy caught-up kitchen (compare 10-empty-pile-state.png). The ONLY error signal is the ~5s auto-dismissing toast. After it dismisses, a chef walking up reads 'kitchen caught up' while the server is actually erroring. The PERSISTENT 'OFFLINE / connection lost since Nm Ns' indicator can NEVER fire on the V2 path: KdsStatusBanner.vue:74 gates that banner on `offlineSince && Date.now()-offlineSince > 60_000`, fed by `v2OfflineSince` which is DECLARED null (KitchenDisplaySystemComponent.vue:1220), BOUND at :38, and ASSIGNED NOWHERE (grep v2OfflineSince resources/js = exactly 2 hits: decl + binding, zero writes). Partial compensation (why P2 not higher): the WS-DOWN case is separately wired (KdsStatusBanner.vue:101 fallbackMode warning banner). Net: list-poll-5xx-with-WS-up is the uncovered case.
findings.fix_hint: resources/js/components/admin/kitchenDisplaySystem/KitchenDisplaySystemComponent.vue (NOT frozen): in the list() poll-failure handler / _raiseKdsErrorBanner, set `this.v2OfflineSince = this.v2OfflineSince || Date.now()` when status>=500 or network-drop, and reset to null on the next successful poll / _clearKdsErrorBanner — so KdsStatusBanner's offlineSince>60s persistent OFFLINE banner actually fires on V2 during a sustained outage instead of leaving a chef on a false 'caught up' empty board. P2: non-blocking, disclose-only.
